body:
### UTC Date & Time

October 22, 2026, 14:00 UTC

Today's facilitator: @adietrichs

### Agenda

- Glamsterdam
  - security concerns around [EIP-8037](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8037) and [EIP-8038](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8038), see [comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2267#issuecomment-6320847921) by @pcaversaccio and [ChainSecurity writeup](https://www.chainsecurity.com/blog/glamsterdam-gas)
  - Hoodi fork on Oct 26
  - mainnet date candidates (Dec 1 / Dec 8 / Dec 9), heads-up only (@barnabasbusa)
    - aim to set the date on ACDC next week, if Hoodi goes smoothly
- Hegotá
  - dynamic base fee calculation for shorter slots: [EIP PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12552) by @barnabasbusa, awareness only, please review
  - CFI priority ordering: [proposed list](https://gist.github.com/nixorokish/1f17a8527d18fcc8d10370c9c1b5583e)
    - aiming for consensus on the call, async follow-up if needed
  - next devnet: `bogota-devnet-2` vs `hegota-devnet-0`
    - `bogota-devnet-2`: one more EL-only devnet, see [comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2267#issuecomment-6296509136) by @wolovim on the frames breakout outcome
      - would need scoping (spec changes + new EIPs), incl. decision on single max fee for frames
    - `hegota-devnet-0`: combine `bogota-devnet-1` with `heze-devnet-3`, see [comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2267#issuecomment-6316613584) by @barnabasbusa re pre-Devcon launch target
      - CL-side scope to be decided on ACDT next week (ACDC as fallback)
  - SFI frames companion EIPs (@lightclient)
    - [EIP-8250](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8250): Keyed Nonces for Frame Transactions
    - [EIP-7906](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7906): Transaction Assertions via State Diff Opcode
    - [EIP-8272](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8272): Recent Roots for Frame Transactions
  - additional CFI decisions
    - [EIP-7907](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7907): Meter Contract Code Size
    - Nethermind revising [EIP-8304](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8304) ranking to A, see [comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2267#issuecomment-6222895327) by @LukaszRozmej
      - related: execution-apis [issue](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/876) and [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/900), see [comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2267#issuecomment-6314102413) by @bomanaps
- Misc
  - modify ACDT time to 90 min (@barnabasbusa)

### Call Series

All Core Devs - Execution

comments.body: Nethermind would like to revise our ranking of https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8304 to A for Hegota. Not sure if that would make other teams reconsider it. We think we should start pushing for trustless RPC and this is a good start.
I’d like to propose a change for ACDT to be 90min long instead of 60.
I'd like to introduce dynamic base fee calculation with the shorter slot eip: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12552

I would like to bring up [this issue](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/876) and the [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/900) I opened for it, and also a comment I left on the [EIP-8304 Ethereum Magicians thread](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8304-trustless-log-and-transaction-index/28824/6?u=bomanaps) around making it compatible.
We should try to make a decision on when we want `hegota-devnet-0` realistically launched. Previously we discussed targeting pre devcon timeframe.

Chainsecurity has identified _serious_ [security risks](https://www.chainsecurity.com/blog/glamsterdam-gas) (impacting the application layer, disclosure to affected protocols is WIP) stemming from the following EIPs:
- https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8037
- https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8038

The fundamental "broken" thing is that `gasleft()` can increase. It's important that the core devs are aware of these findings and discuss this in tomorrow's ACDE. IMHO these findings call for a reassessment of this hard fork but that's not for me to decide of course.

Heads up for this PR aligning the Glamsterdam EIP titles and descriptions with EIP-1:
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12561
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.

Chainsecurity has identified serious security risks (impacting the application layer, disclosure to affected protocols is WIP) stemming from the following EIPs:

https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8037
https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8038
The fundamental "broken" thing is that gasleft() can increase. It's important that the core devs are aware of these findings and discuss this in tomorrow's ACDE. IMHO these findings call for a reassessment of this hard fork but that's not for me to decide of course.




ACDT #103 moved to November 9th; skipping November 2nd due to Devcon • Builder onboarding fix (PR #5736): only 0x0B-prefixed deposits credited to builders at fork; preserves deposit invariant for staking protocols • GetPayload timeout removed (execution-apis PR #958); EL should respond immediately, not delay for better block • Proposed gossip check: reject payloads where tx count exceeds gas_limit / MIN_TRANSACTION_GAS; needs spec PR • Four breaking patterns identified: hardcoded gas, gas-left increases, refund path unlocks, repricing interactions • Francesco: no meaningful findings after com…

**Key decisions**
• **EIP-8037, EIP-8038** — Hoodi fork scheduling delayed minimum 2 weeks; revisit after audits complete
• Builder onboarding fix (consensus-specs PR #5736) approved and will be merged this week
• GetPayload timeout definition removed (execution-apis PR #958 already merged); EL must respond immediately
• Shorter slots remain a feature branch; not merged into Glamsterdam spec until majority client agreement
